label: Bar chart
description: A grouped metric as bars, such as open tickets by team or tickets resolved per week. Every bar opens the explorer filtered to exactly the records it counts. A table with the same numbers is available to screen readers and on request.
usage: Horizontal bars for categories (teams, categories, priorities); vertical bars for time (weeks, months).
Keep to the 12 largest groups; the metric decides the limit.
constraints: metric is required, must exist and must be grouped.
Values are computed on the server under the viewer's permissions.

showTable.description: Show the numbers as a table below the chart.

binding.description: Evaluates the grouped metric for the viewer.

accessibility.keyboard: Tab moves between bars; Enter opens the filtered explorer for a bar.
accessibility.notes: Each bar is a link named "Network: 7"; a visually hidden table repeats all values.

responsive: Vertical charts scroll horizontally inside their card below 480px; labels truncate with a tooltip.
